**Tokenization** is the process of breaking your text into small chunks called tokens — not always full words, sometimes syllables, punctuation marks, or even single characters.

Each token gets converted into a number, because math can't run on letters.

[EX]GPT-4 uses a vocabulary of roughly 100,000 tokens. The sentence "I went to the bank" becomes something like `[40, 1816, 284, 262, 3331]` — a list of IDs the model can actually compute with.[/EX]

[KEY]Tokenization turns your words into numbers before the model processes anything.[/KEY]

Here's why this matters more than it sounds: the model doesn't know what a "word" is. It only knows tokens and their IDs. That's the raw material everything else is built on.
